text.Outland Station:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 1 Trade or 3 Authority. You can also scrap Outland Station to draw a card. Outland Station is a base with a defense of 4. 
 Strategy ==
For only 3 Trade this is a cheap way of getting a Trade Federation base up, which is useful since Trade Federation cards in Frontiers often rely on ally abilities. Since it is not a very powerful card and also not an outpost it will often not be the first target, which is why it may stay for several turns in early game. And whenever you don't need it anymore you can just scrap it to draw another card.
